page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no margin notes. Running head at top with page number left and running title with chapter number right. Catchword-like hyphenated line "& or-" sits at the right below the last line, but is part of the text and is kept as a continuation line. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.l: ius loquitur, capite secundo secundæ Epi-
stolæ ad Thessalonicenses, cujus mysterii na-
tura semel intellecta à vobis probaretur, pro-
bata arriperetur ; denique arrepta vos mo-
veret, imo permoveret, ad perducendum
ejus utilitates ad effectum ; quarum utilita-
tum agmen ducit ruina Papalis imperii & unà
totius Romanensis apparatûs missatici, Re-
ligionis & Ecclesiæ : opus quod, & unius pe-
riodi ambitu exscriberetis, & unius horæ spa-
tio peragueretis : quam utilitatem longè
plures excipiunt, quæ ex intelligentia mysterii
iniquitatis, quam edimus, sunt redundaturæ
in Ecclesias à Papismo reformatas ; imo
in omnes Christianos. Nam cum penè ab
ipsis incunabulis Ecclesiæ Christianæ, diversis,
imo contrariis studiis decertatum fuerit, hinc
ab ordine Ecclesiastico pro imperio, illinc à
Magistratu pro libertate ; Papa inter hæc sibi
imperium struente in Reges & nationes ; nec
unquam orthodoxis & sanctis viris de ordi-
ne Ecclesiastico concordibus inter se, circa
authoritatem Pastorum & Synodorum, & mo-
dum aut imperii, aut obsequii, qui Magi-
stratui debetur circa sacra ; per nostram no-
vam rationem, intellectam, probatam, &
arreptam Papa ruet, & unà totum systema
Romanense, Ecclesiæ, Religionis & missæ cor-
ruet : mutua erit συγκατάβασις Lutherano-
rum & Calvinistarum ; concident, ut exiguo
pulveris jactu apum examina, privatæ stimu-
lationes. & lites inter Pastores ejusdem sectæ
& or-

page.notes: The line "ius loquitur..." is a fragment at the page start. Greek word "συγκατάβασις" is printed in italic and approximated; the reading of the accents is doubtful. Some words in the scan are blurred (e.g. "Romanensis", "Papalis") and may contain printing irregularities.
